description: Read the page as an outline of headings, text and interactive elements. Each element you can act on has a ref like [e14]. Take a snapshot before acting and use the refs in click, type and fill_form. Actions return the page too: the whole outline after a navigation, otherwise only the lines that changed, and refs on unchanged lines keep working. Call this when you need the whole outline again.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

name: snapshot
title: Read page outline
